articles.title_en: How Do Households Respond to Job Loss? Lessons from Multiple High-Frequency Datasets
articles.title_cn: 家庭如何应对失业？来自多个高频数据集的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: How much and through which channels do households self-insure against job loss? Combining data from a large bank and from government sources, we quantify a broad range of responses to job loss in a unified empirical framework. Cumulated over a two-year period, households reduce spending by 30 percent of their income loss. They mainly self-insure through adjustments of liquid balances, which account for 50 percent of the income loss. Other channels—spousal labor supply, private transfers, home equity extraction, mortgage refinancing, and consumer credit—contribute less to self-insurance. Both overall self-insurance and the channels vary with household characteristics in intuitive ways. (JEL D12, G21, G51, J64, J65)
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭在多大程度上以及通过哪些渠道进行自我保险以应对失业？结合一家大型银行和政府来源的数据，我们在一个统一的实证框架中量化了对失业的广泛反应。在两年期间累计，家庭将支出减少了其收入损失的30%。他们主要通过调整流动性余额来自我保险，这占收入损失的50%。其他渠道——配偶劳动供给、私人转移、房屋净值提取、抵押贷款再融资和消费信贷——对自我保险的贡献较小。总体自我保险和各个渠道都随家庭特征以直观的方式变化。（JEL D12, G21, G51, J64, J65）

articles.title_en: Improving Regulatory Effectiveness through Better Targeting: Evidence from OSHA
articles.title_cn: 通过更好的目标定位提高监管有效性：来自OSHA的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how a regulator can best target inspections. Our case study is a US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) program that randomly allocated some inspections. On average, each inspection led to 2.4 (9 percent) fewer serious injuries over the next 5 years. Using new machine learning methods, we find that OSHA could have averted as much as twice as many injuries by targeting inspections to workplaces with the highest expected averted injuries and nearly as many by targeting the highest expected level of injuries. Either approach would have generated up to $850 million in social value over the decade we examine. (JEL C63, J28, J81, K32, L51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究监管机构如何最好地定位检查。我们的案例研究是美国职业安全与健康管理局（OSHA）的一个项目，该项目随机分配了一些检查。平均而言，每次检查在接下来的2.4年内减少了9%（5）起严重伤害。使用新的机器学习方法，我们发现，如果OSHA将检查针对预期可避免伤害最高的工作场所，本可以避免多达两倍的伤害，而针对预期伤害水平最高的工作场所，本可以避免几乎同样多的伤害。在我们考察的十年间，这两种方法中的任何一种本可以产生高达850亿美元的社会价值。（JEL C63, J28, J81, K32, L51）

articles.title_en: Temporal Instability of Risk Preference among the Poor: Evidence from Payday Cycles
articles.title_cn: 贫困群体风险偏好的时间不稳定性：来自发薪日周期的证据
articles.abstract_en: The poor live paycheck to paycheck and are repeatedly exposed to strong cyclical income fluctuations. We investigate whether such income fluctuations affect their risk preference. If risk preference temporarily changes around payday, optimal decisions made before payday may no longer be optimal afterward, which could reinforce poverty. By exploiting social security payday cycles in the United States, we find that the poor relying heavily on social security become more risk tolerant before payday. More than cognitive decline before payday, the deterioration of mental health and relative deprivation are likely to play a role. We find similar evidence among the Japanese elderly. (JEL D81, D91, G51, I12, I32, J14, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 穷人依赖薪水过活，反复暴露于强烈的周期性收入波动中。我们研究这种收入波动是否影响其风险偏好。如果风险偏好在发薪日前后暂时发生变化，那么发薪日前做出的最优决策在之后可能不再最优，这可能加剧贫困。利用美国社会保障发薪日周期，我们发现严重依赖社会保障的穷人在发薪日前变得更加风险容忍。与发薪日前认知衰退相比，心理健康恶化和相对剥夺感更可能发挥作用。我们在日本老年人中也发现了类似证据。(JEL D81, D91, G51, I12, I32, J14, J31)

articles.title_en: Coming Apart? Cultural Distances in the United States over Time
articles.title_cn: 分道扬镳？美国文化距离的历时变化
articles.abstract_en: We analyze trends in cultural distances between groups in the United States defined by income, education, gender, race, and political ideology. We measure cultural distance as the ability to infer an individual's group based on media diet, consumer behavior, time use, social attitudes, or newborn's name. Gender difference in time-use decreased between 1965 and 1995 and has remained constant since. Differences in social attitudes by political ideology, and somewhat by income, have increased over the last four decades. Whites and non-Whites have diverged in consumer behavior. For all other demographic divisions and cultural dimensions, cultural distance has been broadly constant over time. (JEL D12, D91, J15, J16, L82, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国按收入、教育、性别、种族和政治意识形态划分的群体之间文化距离的趋势。我们将文化距离衡量为基于媒体消费、消费者行为、时间使用、社会态度或新生儿姓名推断个人所属群体的能力。性别在时间使用上的差异在1965年至1995年间有所减少，此后保持不变。按政治意识形态划分的社会态度差异，以及在一定程度上按收入划分的差异，在过去四十年中有所增加。白人和非白人在消费者行为上出现分化。对于所有其他人口统计划分和文化维度，文化距离在时间上基本保持不变。（JEL D12, D91, J15, J16, L82, Z13）

articles.title_cn: 移民、犯罪与犯罪（误）感知
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of immigration on crime and crime perceptions in Chile, where the foreign-born population tripled in less than ten years. We document null effects of immigration on crime but positive and significant effects on crime-related concerns and on preventive behavioral responses, such as investing in home security. We explore several channels and provide suggestive evidence related to low- versus high-education immigrants, ethnicity-related intergroup threats, and the role of local media. (JEL D83, D91, J15, K42, L82, O15, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了智利移民对犯罪和犯罪感知的影响，该国外国出生人口在不到十年内增长了两倍。我们记录了移民对犯罪的零效应，但对犯罪相关担忧和预防性行为反应（如投资家庭安全）有显著的正向效应。我们探讨了多个渠道，并提供了与低教育移民和高教育移民、与种族相关的群体间威胁以及地方媒体作用相关的提示性证据。（JEL D83, D91, J15, K42, L82, O15, O17）

articles.title_en: Coordination and Bandwagon Effects: How Past Rankings Shape the Behavior of Voters and Candidates
articles.title_cn: 协调与从众效应：过去的排名如何塑造选民和候选人的行为
articles.abstract_en: Candidates' placements in polls and past elections can be powerful coordination devices for parties and voters. Using a regression discontinuity design in French two-round elections, we show that candidates who place first in the first round are more likely to stay in the race and win than those who placed second. These effects are even larger for ranking second versus third, and also present for third versus fourth. They stem from allied parties agreeing on which candidate should drop out, voters coordinating their choice, and the bandwagon effect of wanting to vote for the winner. We find similar results across 19 other countries. (JEL D72, D83, D91, K16)
articles.abstract_cn: 候选人在民调和过往选举中的排名可以成为政党和选民的强大协调工具。利用法国两轮选举中的断点回归设计，我们表明在第一轮中排名第一的候选人比排名第二的候选人更有可能留在竞选中并获胜。这些效应对于排名第二与第三之间的比较甚至更大，并且在第三与第四之间也存在。它们源于联盟政党就哪位候选人应退出达成一致、选民协调其选择，以及希望投票给获胜者的从众效应。我们在其他19个国家发现了类似的结果。(JEL D72, D83, D91, K16)

articles.title_en: Contagious Dishonesty: Corruption Scandals and Supermarket Theft
articles.title_cn: 不诚实的传染性：腐败丑闻与超市盗窃
articles.abstract_en: Is dishonest behavior contagious? We answer this question by studying whether corruption scandals affect the propensity of supermarket customers to steal while using a self-service checkout system. Crucially, this system allows shoppers to engage in dishonest behavior by underreporting the value of their shopping cart. Exploiting data from random audits on shoppers, we show that the probability of stealing increases by 16 percent after a local corruption scandal breaks. This effect is not driven by any change in material incentives. Suggestive evidence shows that it is driven by a reduction in the self-imposed cost of stealing. (JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 不诚实行为是否具有传染性？我们通过研究腐败丑闻是否影响超市顾客在使用自助结账系统时偷窃的倾向来回答这个问题。关键在于，该系统允许购物者通过低报其购物车价值来从事不诚实行为。利用对购物者随机审计的数据，我们表明，在当地腐败丑闻爆发后，偷窃的概率增加了16%。这一效应并非由物质激励的任何变化所驱动。提示性证据表明，它是由偷窃自我施加成本的降低所驱动的。(JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)

articles.abstract_en: Marriage rates have become increasingly stratified by homeownership. We investigate this in a household model where investments in public goods reduce future earnings and, thus, divorce risk creates inefficiencies. Access to a joint savings technology, like a house, collateralizes marriage, providing insurance to the lower-earning partner and increasing specialization, public goods, and value from marriage. We use idiosyncratic variation in housing prices to show that homeownership access indeed leads to greater specialization. The model also predicts that policies that erode the marriage contract in other ways will make wealth a more important determinant of marriage, which we confirm empirically. (JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 结婚率日益按房屋所有权分层。我们在一个家庭模型中研究这一问题，其中公共品投资会降低未来收入，因此离婚风险造成低效率。获得联合储蓄技术（如房屋）的机会将婚姻抵押化，为低收入伴侣提供保险，并增加专业化、公共品和婚姻价值。我们利用房价的异质性变化表明，获得房屋所有权确实导致更大的专业化。该模型还预测，以其他方式侵蚀婚姻契约的政策将使财富成为婚姻更重要的决定因素，我们在实证中证实了这一点。（JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31）

articles.title_en: How Cable News Reshaped Local Government
articles.title_cn: 有线新闻如何重塑地方政府
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that partisan cable news broadcasts have a causal effect on the size and composition of budgets in US localities. Using exogenous channel positioning as an instrument for viewership, we show that exposure to the conservative Fox News channel reduces revenues and expenditures. Multiple mechanisms drive these results: Fox News improves election chances for local Republicans, alters politician campaign agendas, and shifts voter policy preferences on fiscal issues. Consistent with the priorities of small-government conservatism, we find evidence that private provision compensates for the reduced public services. The “Fox News effect” extends beyond vote shares to rightward policy shifts. (JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，党派有线新闻广播对美国地方政府的预算规模和构成具有因果效应。利用外生的频道定位作为收视率的工具变量，我们表明接触保守派福克斯新闻频道会减少收入和支出。多种机制驱动这些结果：福克斯新闻提高了地方共和党人的选举机会，改变了政治家的竞选议程，并转变了选民在财政问题上的政策偏好。与小政府保守主义的优先事项一致，我们发现证据表明私人供给补偿了减少的公共服务。“福克斯新闻效应”超越了选票份额，延伸至右翼政策转变。（JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82）

articles.title_en: Hidden Income and the Perceived Returns to Migration
articles.title_cn: 隐藏收入与迁移的感知回报
articles.abstract_en: In many developing economies, urban workers earn substantially more than rural workers with the same level of education. Why don't more rural workers migrate to cities? I use two field experiments in Kenya to show that low migration is partly due to underestimation of urban incomes, which is sustained by income hiding by migrants. Parents at the origin underestimate their migrant children's incomes by nearly half, and underestimation is greater when a migrant's remittance obligations are high. Providing information about urban earnings increases migration to the capital city by about 40 percent over two years. (JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中经济体，城市工人比同等教育水平的农村工人收入高得多。为什么没有更多农村工人迁移到城市？我在肯尼亚进行了两项实地实验，表明低迁移率部分是由于对城市收入的低估，而这种低估是由迁移者隐藏收入所维持的。原籍地的父母低估其迁移子女的收入近一半，当迁移者的汇款义务较高时，低估程度更大。提供关于城市收入的信息使前往首都城市的迁移在两年内增加了约40%。(JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)

articles.title_en: Returns to International Migration: Evidence from a Bangladesh-Malaysia Visa Lottery
articles.title_cn: 国际移民的回报：来自孟加拉国-马来西亚签证抽签的证据
articles.abstract_en: South Asians traveling to richer Asian nations is the world's largest migration corridor. We track down applicants to a government lottery that randomly allocated visas to Bangladeshis for temporary labor contracts in Malaysia, five years later. Most lottery winners migrate, and migrants' earnings triple. Their remittance raises their family's standard of living in Bangladesh. The migrant's absence pauses marriage and childbirth and shifts decision-making power toward females. Migration removes enterprising individuals, lowering household entrepreneurship, but does not crowd out other family members' labor supply. A deferred migration offer never materialized for a subgroup. Their premigration investments in skills generate no returns in the domestic market. (JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 南亚人前往较富裕的亚洲国家是世界上最大的移民走廊。我们追踪了一项政府抽签的申请人，该抽签随机分配签证给孟加拉国人，以便他们在马来西亚获得临时劳动合同，五年后进行调查。大多数中签者移民，移民的收入增加了两倍。他们的汇款提高了家人在孟加拉国的生活水平。移民的缺席推迟了婚姻和生育，并将决策权转向女性。移民带走了有创业精神的个体，降低了家庭创业，但并未挤出其他家庭成员的家庭劳动力供给。一个推迟的移民提议对某个亚组从未实现。他们在移民前对技能的投资在国内市场没有产生回报。(JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)

articles.title_en: Civil Liberties in Times of Crisis
articles.abstract_en: We study people's willingness to trade off civil liberties for increased health security in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic by deploying representative surveys involving around 550,000 responses across 15 countries. We document significant heterogeneity across groups in willingness to sacrifice rights: citizens disadvantaged by income, education, or race are less willing to sacrifice rights than their more advantaged peers in every country. Leveraging naturally occurring variation and experimental approaches, we estimate a one standard deviation increase in health insecurity increases willingness to sacrifice civil liberties by 68–83 percent of the difference between the average Chinese and US citizen. (JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过部署涉及约19万份回复、覆盖550000个国家的代表性调查，研究在COVID-15大流行背景下人们愿意以公民自由换取更高健康安全的程度。我们记录了不同群体在牺牲权利意愿上的显著异质性：在每个国家，收入、教育或种族方面处于不利地位的公民比其更有利的同伴更不愿意牺牲权利。利用自然发生的变异和实验方法，我们估计健康不安全感增加一个标准差会使牺牲公民自由的意愿增加平均中国公民与美国公民差异的68-83%。（JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36）

articles.title_en: Discrimination in Times of Crises and the Role of the Media
articles.title_cn: 危机时期的歧视与媒体的作用
articles.abstract_en: Can the extent of ethnic discrimination change quickly, and what circumstances and mechanisms make such changes possible? I address these questions by using scraped data to study the daily evolution of customer discrimination against Arab doctors in Israel from January 2020 to June 2021. Results show that: (1) the outbreak of the coronavirus crisis in March 2020 led to a dramatic decline in discrimination; (2) the eruption of a wave of ethnic riots in May 2021 had the opposite effect; (3) media coverage of the contribution of Arab doctors to the fight against the pandemic helped bring about the first change. (JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 种族歧视的程度能否迅速变化，哪些环境和机制使这种变化成为可能？我通过使用抓取的数据研究以色列阿拉伯医生在2020年一月至2021年六月期间顾客歧视的日常演变来回答这些问题。结果表明：（1）2020年三月冠状病毒危机的爆发导致歧视急剧下降；（2）2021年五月种族骚乱的爆发产生了相反的效果；（3）媒体对阿拉伯医生抗击疫情的贡献的报道有助于促成第一个变化。（JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82）

articles.title_en: Physical Disability and Labor Market Discrimination: Evidence from a Video Résumé Field Experiment
articles.title_cn: 身体残疾与劳动力市场歧视：来自视频简历实地实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We sent fictitious applications to firms advertising job openings. We find that revealing a disability decreases callback rates by 25 percentage points. This result is not explained by accessibility constraints or lower productivity due to disability. We find that including a video résumé of a well-spoken applicant significantly increases callbacks by 10 percentage points for persons with and without disabilities, suggesting that discrimination is unaffected by quality signals in our context. Analysis of viewing activity suggests that employers seek less information when the applicant is disabled. Disclosing the disability later in the video increases employers' viewing time but leaves callback rates unchanged. (JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们向发布招聘广告的公司发送了虚构的求职申请。我们发现，披露残疾会使回电率降低25个百分点。这一结果并非由无障碍限制或残疾导致的生产率下降所解释。我们发现，包含一位口齿清晰的申请人的视频简历会显著提高有残疾和无残疾申请人的回电率10个百分点，这表明在我们的情境中，歧视不受质量信号的影响。对观看活动的分析表明，当申请人为残疾人时，雇主会寻求更少的信息。在视频中较晚披露残疾会增加雇主的观看时间，但回电率保持不变。(JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)

articles.title_en: The Effect of Hospital Postpartum Care Regulations on Breastfeeding and Maternal Time Allocation
articles.title_cn: 医院产后护理法规对母乳喂养和母亲时间分配的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of state hospital regulations intended to increase breastfeeding by requiring certain standards of care during the immediate postpartum hospital stay. We find that these regulations significantly increased breastfeeding initiation by 3.8 percentage points (5.1 percent) and the probability of breastfeeding at 3 and 6 months postpartum by approximately 7 percent. We also provide evidence that these breastfeeding-promoting policies significantly increased maternal time spent on child care, crowding out time spent on formal work. Observed reductions in employment are concentrated among mothers with infants between zero and three months of age. (JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了旨在通过要求产后住院期间特定护理标准来增加母乳喂养的州医院法规的影响。我们发现这些法规显著提高了母乳喂养的启动率，增加了3.8个百分点（5.1%），并使得产后3个月和6个月时母乳喂养的概率大约提高了7%。我们还提供了证据表明，这些促进母乳喂养的政策显著增加了母亲用于儿童护理的时间，挤占了用于正式工作的时间。观察到的就业减少主要集中在婴儿年龄在零到三个月之间的母亲中。（JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22）
